question: What word means to eat or drink noisily?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Bibble**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bibble"** means to eat or drink noisily. (शोरगुल से खाना या पीना)
 
 
• **Example:** The child bibbled his soup loudly, causing the others to laugh.
 
 
• Hence, the correct word for eating or drinking noisily is **"Bibble"**. (शोरगुल से खाना या पीना)
 
 
• **Example:** During the party, he bibbled his drink while chatting with friends.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Bibble**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Psithurism** (पत्तियों की सरसराहट): The sound of rustling leaves or wind blowing through trees.
 
 
• **Example:** The psithurism of the trees created a calming atmosphere during the evening walk.
 
 
 
• **Taradiddle** (झूठ या बकवास): A petty lie or nonsense.
 
 
• **Example:** His story about meeting a celebrity was nothing but a taradiddle.
 
 
 
• **Abulia** (इच्छाशक्ति की कमी): A lack of willpower or inability to make decisions.
 
 
• **Example:** His abulia made it difficult for him to choose a career path.
